verdict.rationale: The Agent API generates LLM answers from whatever input you send it. Its sandbox tool can run code to produce "a transformed dataset, or a generated report", and a classification endpoint returns calibrated judgments about your own text, JSON or images. So AI analysis of user-supplied data is a documented first-party capability. However, the product is a developer API oriented toward web-grounded search, not a hosted surface that proactively surfaces insights or suggestions from data stored in the product. Users must pass their data in per request and build the experience themselves. Missing for 10: an in-product insights or suggestions experience over the user's stored data, proactive or automatic recommendations, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of data-analysis quality.
